prompt:
Our shared ML development server is critically low on disk space. The workspace at /workspace has accumulated months of abandoned experiments, old virtual environments, stale frontend builds, and forgotten dependency folders across multiple nested projects. Nobody knows exactly what is eating the disk.

I need you to do a thorough audit of the entire /workspace directory — make sure you go deep, don't miss anything hiding in subdirectories. Cover both Python and JavaScript/Node environments. Identify which environments are broken or stale. Produce a cleanup plan that shows what *would* be removed, but don't actually delete anything yet.

Save the complete findings as a JSON report file named exactly `envoic_report.json` somewhere under /workspace so I can review it and share it with the team.
